supersedes.reason: Fresh immutable Make pair includes final SemanticRemote nonce ownership guard; the earlier native artifacts and proof remain preserved.

scope: Actual native FinalPublication and TargetBinding phase-boundary FD census, with lazy resource runtime and minimum Source/Consumer budgets.
Original six native groups retain exact source bytes, borrowed validation, Source headroom, producer handoff/commit/release and failure/retry behavior.

Two private Runtime success-continuation faults execute after actual four-FD Ready preparation and cancellation cleanup: immediate grant and genuinely queued asynchronous grant. Both preserve the original exception, close native ownership before retirement and complete admitted retry.

Private pre-fix cleanup removes only recorded-native-owner closure, preserving all other guards; both synchronous and asynchronous cases reject the resulting actual FD escape. Two existing private regressions detect producer early retirement and nested-consumer admission deadlock.
No transient native FD-peak measurement, global allocator exhaustion, universal asynchronous recovery, whole-process FD/RSS cap or external child/SDK resource bound.

Compiler-matched retained Make snapshots are identified by linked object and source pins, including final SemanticRemote nonce source; nonce behavior itself has separate integration qualification. No Photo, Adobe, Lightroom, catalog/cache or production data access.
